title: Unit-normalized comparison of actual completion with reduction and total limit
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, and a scheme X with l a unit in every local ring. For a coefficient reduction/total-limit calculus C [def-coef-derived-system-calculus-data], an ordinary quotient model O and its normalized derived model D [def-trf-completion-unit-models], the actual completion functor of [def-pur-integral-derived-operations] is naturally isomorphic to C.reduction followed by the specified total limit. The comparison carries the actual completion unit to C.adjunction.unit at every object; there are no boundedness or completeness assumptions.

source.place: Completed-operation primitive models, original construction steps 1--6; tensor comparison by Stacks 08J9 and completion by 07A6, 08TC, 0941.

proof.text: Use the normalized Roos model constructed from O,D. Apply isomorphismMultiplicationConeDescent to the identity of X to obtain the strict representative-normalized comparison rho. Transport IntegralOnSlice.completionComparison across the equality of its global quotient tower with trfQuotientTowerFunctor, and lift rho through the fully faithful good-representative whiskering to get the natural completion comparison.

proof.text: The quotient augmentation agrees with unrestrictedTowerUnit by their sectionwise 1-tensor-x characterizations. Transport along equality of the two towers; both mapping cocone lifts have the same product coordinate and zero shifted coordinate, so the Roos unit maps agree. strictQuotientCompletionUnit identifies the calculus unit followed by rho with this strict augmentation. Fully faithful whiskering and uniqueness of the actual completion unit extend this equation from good representatives to all derived objects. Cancel the comparison inverse to obtain the stated unit equation.

theorem normalizedCompletionRealization
    (C : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus l E X)
    (O : CompletionUnit.OrdinaryModel l E X)
    (D : CompletionUnit.DerivedModel l E X C O)
    (hl : ∀ x : X, IsUnit (l : X.presheaf.stalk x)) :
    ∃ c : (IntegralOnSlice.completion l E X none :
        DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource l E X) ⥤
          DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource l E X)) ≅
      C.reduction ⋙ coefficientSequenceLimit l E X,
      ∀ K : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource l E X),
        (IntegralOnSlice.completionUnit l E X none).app K ≫ c.hom.app K =
        C.adjunction.unit.app K
